heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy. Scattered rain showers spreading north. A chance of afternoon thunderstorms spreading from northern New York across the Greens this evening. Highs from the mid 70s to near 80. South wind near 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with showers in the evening, becoming spotty overnight. Chance of storms after dark. Partial clearing late. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Southwest wind near 10 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Partly cloudy south of Rt. 4, increasing clouds north with rain showers. Showers spreading in the afternoon with a chance of thunderstorms. Cooler. Highs from the mid to upper 70s. Southwest wind near 10 mph.
